_comment: tests/ipad1/jank.py --gate thresholds. The metric is deterministic in virtual time (icount + vsync-stepped input): every recorded run read every frame on the next vsync, so any missed refresh fails. min_frames sits under the observed frame count to leave slack for a small legitimate change. 'baseline' is the recorded verdict (jank-harness 0738fdb40a on qemu-ios 0a2fc35669, 3.2.2 golden, iop-core=off; frame-identical at load 89-206 and 151-165).
